newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar ends higher after trade in tight range.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar ends higher after trade in tight range.

text.p: LIFFE sugar ended a quiet week with active May near its high, having traded in a tight range throughout the day.
But while May rose $1.00 to $311.00, just off its $311.20 high of the day, August ended unchanged at $307.70, well off a high of $308.40.
Volume of a total 2,618 lots was inflated by May-August switches, traders said. May and August dominated, with 1,551 lots on May and 936 on August.
Traders said the market was now supported by buyers prepared to come in below $310.00 on May, Thursday's close.
"It's stuck in the same stalemate," one trader said. A rangebound New York had failed to give a lead, while there was no fundamental news to move the market, he said.
